question: When can I apply for OPT?
answer: As an F-1 student, you can apply for OPT during a window around your program completion: - You can apply up to 90 days before and up to 60 days after completing your program [3][4]. - Per the Belhaven FAQ, USCIS must receive your application before your program end date [3].
